meta.title: Jared Lilliss — builds that keep running
meta.description: Jared Lilliss — Sydney field technician and builder. Data pipelines that survive reboots, single-file websites that work offline, automation with receipts.

hero.headline: I build things that keep running after I go home.
hero.lede: Data pipelines that survive reboots, single-file websites that work offline, automation with receipts. By day I'm the IT field tech venues ring when the tills stop — the rest of the time I build the systems below.

projects.title: Aussie Health Utility
body: A privacy-by-design data platform over public Australian health datasets: a polling loop feeding an append-only PostgreSQL time series of emergency-department wait times, with the privacy posture set at the schema level — no personal or health information is ever collected. Runs unattended on a Melbourne VPS with health-checked collection, daily dumps, and automated offsite backups. Tens of thousands of readings and growing.

projects.title: Still Wild — concept rebuild
body: A modern concept page for a real Brisbane adventure business, built as one self-contained HTML file: a live canvas dawn scene, five-language dictionary (EN · 简体 · 繁體 · 日本語 · 한국어), and an honesty layer that labels every invented detail — the placeholder prices and concept copy are tagged as exactly that.

projects.title: The Ascent — template test
body: A hi-tech design-template evaluation restyling public content from a space-industry initiative: an Earth-to-Mars scroll narrative with mission-phase telemetry, an Earth-limb canvas scene, and outlined-numeral typography — all vanilla, all offline-capable, clearly labelled as an unofficial template test.

projects.title: Lilliss IT
body: My trading identity: small-business IT across Sydney and regional NSW — point-of-sale and payment terminals, Windows fleets, structured cabling, cameras. One person from fault intake to fix. Trading since 2019, registered 2026.
